title: The 409 refusing termal_release_named_root for a session's own current binding should name the supported clear form
outcome: An agent whose own named root is refused by termal_release_named_root because it holds the current binding is told how to retire that root by the supported route.
acceptance: The 409 refusal that termal_release_named_root returns when the calling session itself holds the current binding for the root's claim names the supported route for retiring its own root (termal_name_source_root with the work and no root), and the refusal for another session's live claim stays unchanged.
A test asserts that the own-binding refusal text names that route.

completion.summary: Landed own-binding release refusal guidance on master/origin ee2f21c6. The existing 409 now names termal_name_source_root with work and omitted path for the actual own holder; other live-claim refusals, root retention and audit behavior remain unchanged. Regression passed in registered Windows focus; independent Codex/Claude pair clean (Notes only); integration owner recorded clean eligible identical-tree five-stage DL560 FULL. Install remains pending, no running-build claim.
